name: fiery-swing-decline-second-banish-still-applies-power-bonus
notes: Fiery Swing: [Class Bonus] On Attack, banish one fire card from the graveyard then decline the second offer. The decline used to skip FierySwingBanish, so the +1 POWER for the card already banished was never applied (7 damage became 6).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Fiery Swing's optional-choice continuation (FierySwingBanish) was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the prompt (PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods skip the handler and its "if you don't" branch never ran: the +1 POWER for the already banished card was lost. Fix: the queue site passes dontSkipOnPass and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
